title: Defence drones, designed from scratch.
standfirst: Ansar H Lone co-founded Comrado Aerospace, which designs drones, mostly for defence, at ARTGarage, part of the incubation system at ARTPARK @ IISc in Bengaluru. Drones are getting cheaper fast, and India wants more of them designed at home rather than imported.

hero.alt: The main hall at ARTGarage, a former factory with a high steel roof, shelves, seating and work desks
hero.caption: The main hall at ARTGarage, the ARTPARK @ IISc facility where Comrado Aerospace is based. ARTPARK photograph, not of Comrado Aerospace.

lead: “The drone technology is maturing at such a speed that the cost is going down drastically. The moment drone tech becomes accessible to all, our skies are bound to be filled with them,” says Ansar H Lone, co-founder and CEO of Comrado Aerospace.

His company is preparing for that sky. Ansar is also ARTPARK’s Program Director for UAV platforms, and Comrado works out of ARTGarage in Jalahalli, Bengaluru, the manufacturing and testing facility for robotics and autonomous systems within the incubation system of ARTPARK @ IISc.

blocks: Comrado’s team, now around 40 or 50 people, builds drones from scratch, mostly for military use. Almost everything is designed in-house, and manufacturing is outsourced to partners in India. In July 2025, ThePrint described Comrado’s workspace at ARTGarage as the size of three football turfs.

When AlgoBotix, its neighbour at ARTGarage, tested its drone traffic management system that summer, one of the drones in the air was built by Comrado. In December 2025, the team carried a mock-up of a Viraat-series surveillance drone through HSR Layout, Bengaluru, for an event. It drew attention on the street, and there was an excess crowd at the entry.

figure.alt: Computer render of a Comrado-branded twin-boom VTOL fixed-wing drone flying above a city and clouds
figure.caption: A render of a Comrado VTOL fixed-wing drone, from the company’s website. This is a computer illustration, not a photograph.

panel.title: What Comrado builds
items: Drones for surveillance, reconnaissance and tactical missions.
Fixed-wing drones that take off and land vertically.
Drones for precision agriculture, infrastructure inspection and cargo.

blocks: Comrado says it was nurtured through the support of ARTPARK, with early funding from the Department of Science and Technology and the Government of Karnataka.

It began as one of the pre-venture teams in CAMRAS, the industry accelerator the Ministry of Heavy Industries set up at ARTPARK. Six teams led CAMRAS projects as pre-ventures, funded by the programme, and became startups: Twara Robotics, Comrado Aerospace, Strider Robotics, AlgoFET, VayDyn and Yaanendriya. They were incubated under the Startup @ ARTPARK programme and seed funded by DST.
